FIELDS.NAME: Embroidered Expressions
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Custom St, Suite 100, Creative City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Embroidered Expressions specializes in high-quality embroidery and custom apparel production, serving a diverse clientele that includes organizations, schools, and corporate clients. Our operations involve the use of commercial-grade embroidery and screen printing equipment, which is meticulously maintained to ensure safety and efficiency. We prioritize quality and reliability by sourcing materials from established vendors and have implemented rigorous health and safety protocols for our staff. Our production area is distinctly separate from administrative spaces to streamline workflow and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. We operate within the bounds of local zoning and occupancy regulations, maintaining compliance with safety codes to ensure a secure environment for our operations. With a commitment to excellence, we also maintain a documented quality control process to minimize customer complaints and returns.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Custom Creations LLC - A local business specializing in personalized gifts and custom screen printing services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, a malfunction in the embroidery machine caused damage to several fabric rolls and incurred repair costs amounting to $3,000. Status: Resolved, all repairs completed and equipment is operational now.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 5678 Stitch Ave, Suite 200, Creative City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, class U, grade B, UL listed for cash and valuables storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Local security patrol service on weekends to reduce theft risk.
